messages:
maria_cs: Hey team — Cedarline (third-party logistics) just asked to onboard a custom "inventory anomaly" model. They want near-real-time alerts for stockouts and ghost inventory, and they're sensitive about customer PII and contractor IDs in their feed. They sent sample schema + retention rules.

jordan_se: Thanks Maria. Do we have the model artifact yet or just training data?

maria_cs: Only training data and a model spec from their ML vendor (proprietary 7B transformer). They asked about private deployment + KMS/HSM for keys, and whether we can meet 200ms p50 and 600ms p95 for 512-token inference.

sam_research: 7B is doable on Dedicated with quantization. Need to validate compatibility w/ our runtime (KV cache, attention patterns). Also we should ask for a representative eval set with true positives/negatives.

jordan_se: I'll schedule a call with Cedarline to get the eval set and clarify PII fields. Suggested time tomorrow 11am PT. @sam_research can you join?

sam_research: Can do. Quick checklist I want on the call: data retention window, schema for identifier fields, example anomaly types, expected false positive tolerance, and how they label events.

maria_cs: Cedarline's success mgr said they label by "manual reconciliation" and care most about precision > 0.9 for anomalies (they prefer fewer false alarms). They also flagged GDPR concerns for EU warehouses.

kevin_platform: From infra/Platform side: private (VPC) + HSM OK but will need a brief security review and an HA capacity plan. For latency we'll probably recommend Dedicated with 2x warm replicas and autoscaling burst to handle spikes.

opsbot: new-ticket #CS-4827 created: Cedarline inventory anomaly onboarding. Owner: maria_cs.

jordan_se: Proposed evaluation criteria (high level): precision >= 0.9, recall >= 0.7 on their labeled eval set, end-to-end latency p95 <= 600ms, and throughput target 200 rps sustained for batch windows. Can we run shadowing on production stream for 2 weeks?

sam_research: Shadowing is fine but needs throttles. Also request a small held-out labeled validation file (CSV) with at least 5k rows covering EU and NA. We'll run: 
```
- metrics: precision, recall, f1, latency_p50/p95
- eval script: run_eval.py --pred preds.csv --gold gold.csv --metrics precision recall f1
```

maria_cs: Cedarline can provide 6k labeled rows, but their dataset contains contractor_id (PII) and customer_phone hashed. They want us to avoid storing raw contractor_id and to use tokenization + redaction in logs.

kevin_platform: We'll enable token redaction in ingest pipeline and set logs to exclude full identifiers. Also recommend Private deployment with Customer-managed keyring in HSM. Need CS legal to sign DPA addendum.

jordan_se: Next steps: 1) legal + security to review DPA & HSM path (maria to help) 2) Sam to test model spec compatibility & run initial eval on their sample 3) Kevin to draft Dedicated capacity proposal and latency SLOs 4) Schedule kickoff w/ Cedarline and their vendor. Target: initial eval within 10 business days.

maria_cs: Sounds good. I'm noting potential renewal risk: Cedarline is a large account and wants solid SLAs before committing to reserved capacity. If we miss p95 latency they're likely to push back on the Dedicated purchase.

sam_research: I'll start with a dry-run compatibility check. If the artifact is incompatible, we may recommend an ONNX conversion or a 4-bit quant path. I'll post results in this thread by EOD +3 (timestamp approx +259200s).

jordan_se: Thanks everyone — I'll confirm the call time and invite legal/security. @maria_cs can you get the eval CSV and the model spec URL into the ticket?

maria_cs: Yep — uploading files to CS-4827 now and will ping when ready. :thumbsup:

opsbot: Cedarline-call scheduled: 2025-05-07T18:00:00Z (calendar invite sent).
